title: The Alpha 21264: NT's Greatest RISC

[Editor's note: This article was originally scheduled for publication in the September 1998 issue of BYTE Magazine but was canceled when BYTE folded in June 1998. It appeared instead in Windows NT Magazine and in C'T, a German computer magazine. This text is the original English version.]

While the world waits for Intel's 64-bit Merced chip and Microsoft's 64-bit version of Windows NT, Digital Equipment is offering a sneak preview of the next generation in NT processing. The Alpha 21264 is a 64-bit processor that runs NT. It's one of the fastest chips in the world. And it's available today.

The 21264 is the latest generation of the Alpha microprocessor architecture. Digital expects the 21264 to reach clock speeds of more than 700MHz this year, so this processor upholds the speed demon reputation that the 21164 and 21064 established for Alpha chips.

Alpha is the last RISC architecture for which Microsoft is developing future versions of NT. Microsoft is phasing out NT for MIPS Rx000 chips, and the PowerPC NT never really got off the ground. The only other CPU architecture that runs NT is, of course, Intel x86. Despite Intel's market dominance, the Alpha has one big advantage over the x86: increased performance, especially performance of floating-point tasks. Alpha systems generally cost more than their Intel counterparts, but Alpha systems are faster, and they excel at math-intensive engineering and scientific applications.

To move beyond the performance limitations of the 20-year-old x86, Intel partnered with HP in 1994 to develop a new CPU architecture: Intel Architecture-64 (IA-64). Intel expects systems that use the Merced processor, the first processor to implement IA-64, to ship in mid-2000. But the Merced might not be the fastest chip on the NT market in 2000. Digital says that by the time Merced appears, the 21264 will be running at a clock frequency of 1000MHz (1 gigahertz [GHz]). At that speed, the 21264 will be substantially faster than the Merced according to estimated CPU benchmarks. (For a review of 21264 speeds, see Figure 1.)

Digital said the first 21264 systems would hit the streets in late 1998, so you don't have to wait two years for 64-bit performance. However, the 21264 won't reach its potential until Microsoft ships a 64-bit version of NT for both IA-64 and Alpha chips. (Microsoft hopes to ship the 64-bit NT in 2000.)

Whither RISC?

The race between the 21264 and IA-64 processors is not just a subject of idle gossip. At stake is nothing less than the future of RISC ­for NT and every other operating system (OS).

Outside of the highly specialized embedded-application market, RISC is in retreat. Currently, the most popular RISC architecture for the desktop is the PowerPC chip, which IBM and Motorola produce jointly. But the largest customer for desktop PowerPC chips is Apple, and the Macintosh has only about 4 percent of the PC market share according to International Data Corporation (IDC). In June, IBM and Motorola announced that they are dissolving their 7-year PowerPC partnership and will develop future PowerPC chips separately.

IBM's other RISC architecture, the Power series, is merging with the PowerPC. IBM is phasing out the Power chip as a distinct architecture. The new 64-bit Power3 chip is the first processor that unifies Power and PowerPC technologies.

Battling recent losses, Silicon Graphics is moving away from its MIPS Rx000-series RISC processors. Silicon Graphics canceled its next-generation Rx000 projects and recently spun off the embedded-chip portion of MIPS Technologies as a separate company. Silicon Graphics is developing x86-based systems for NT and porting IRIX to IA-64.

Sun Microsystems is porting Solaris to IA-64. That move has prompted some industry analysts to speculate that the new UltraSPARC-III will be the last major generation of the SPARC family, although Sun claims that the rumors are false.

HP is porting HP-UX to IA-64 as part of its strategy to move away from Precision Architecture-RISC. PA-RISC will gradually exit the market after IA-64 debuts. IA-64 will be backward compatible with PA-RISC.

The Alpha is the fastest RISC chip according to most CPU benchmarks and the only NT alternative to the x86. But the Alpha's future isn't certain because of recent shakeups at Digital. The company sold its chip foundry in Hudson, Massachusetts, to Intel. Despite some misleading news reports, Digital sold only the foundry, not the Alpha. Digital will continue to independently design Alpha processors but will farm out the chips' manufacturing to Intel and other licensees. The two current Alpha-manufacturing licensees are Samsung and Mitsubishi. Digital is also negotiating deals with AMD and IBM Microelectronics. Mitsubishi currently has no plans to manufacture the 21264, although the company continues to provide technical support for the low-cost 21164PC chips it manufactured. Samsung has emerged as the most aggressive Alpha licensee. It recently formed a subsidiary to market Alpha chips and says it will push the 21264 to 1GHz by 2000.

Compaq's acquisition of Digital makes the Alpha's fate more uncertain. Compaq has never owned a CPU architecture, and the company is one of Intel's largest customers for x86 chips. David Jessel, the Alpha's senior product manager, claims that Alpha fans have nothing to worry about. "Compaq has been fully supportive of the Alpha and is continuing to invest in it," Jessel said. To underscore its commitment to the Alpha, Compaq plans to substitute the 21264 for MIPS processors in its high-end Tandem servers.

If the Alpha survives all these transitions, it could seriously challenge IA-64 chips for performance supremacy in the next decade. A technical analysis of the 21264 shows that the Alpha has plenty of room to become more powerful.

Inside the 21264

The 21264 has an innovative design that departs significantly from the 21164's design. The new chip has larger primary caches, additional functional units, more accurate branch prediction, new motion video instructions (MVI), and high bus bandwidth. It executes as many as six instructions per clock cycle and sustains four instructions per clock cycle. In addition, the 21264 is the first Alpha to offer out-of-order execution.

Out-of-order execution is a feature common to many microprocessors. Now that the Alpha offers this feature, Sun's SPARC chips are the only leading CPUs that don't execute instructions out of order. CPUs that run out of order dynamically rearrange a program's instructions at runtime to use the chip's resources efficiently. For example, if an instruction needs an integer unit but all the CPU's integer units are busy, an out-of-order CPU dispatches floating-point instructions to available floating-point units (FPUs) while holding the stalled integer instruction until an integer unit becomes available. When an integer unit becomes available, the CPU releases the stalled instruction. In the same situation, conventional in-order CPUs stall all instructions until the integer unit is free. Out-of-order CPUs always retire results in their original program order.

Out-of-order execution used to be a characteristic of only brainiac processors, CPUs that rely on sophisticated instruction handling, not high clock speeds, to achieve top performance. The complex logic that manages older chips' out-of-order technique rules out high clock speeds. Previous Alpha chips ran at industry-leading speeds because they did not process instructions out of order.

The 21264 breaks from that tradition. Available at 500MHz and 600MHz, it's definitely fast. And it will become faster. Digital says the 21264 will hit 733MHz this year and 1GHz within 2 years. But the 21264 is also a brainiac. It executes instructions out of order, and it does so more deftly than any other processor.

The best way to evaluate the 21264's out-of-order efficiency is to examine the number of instructions it arranges at once. The more instructions an out-of-order CPU holds at one time, the more efficient its processing is because juggling many instructions gives a CPU a broader view of a running program's needs. However, this juggling act requires resources that in-order processing doesn't require: reorder logic, temporary registers to hold values for pending instructions, interlock circuitry to check for dependencies, and logic to retire the results in program order.

Intel's P6 chips (Pentium Pros, Pentium IIs, Celerons, and Pentium II Xeons) juggle as many as 40 instructions simultaneously. HP's PA-8000 handles 56 instructions at once. The 21264 juggles 80 instructions, more instructions than any other processor.

Digital implemented a clever register scheme to make this instruction handling possible. Like most RISC chips, the 21264 has an architectural set of 32 integer registers and 32 floating-point registers, all 64 bits wide. To increase the CPU's capacity for reordering instructions, the 21264 has 48 extra integer registers and 40 extra floating-point registers. Any of these 152 registers can hold temporary values for pending instructions. When an instruction retires, the CPU renames the register that holds the temporary result, so that register represents one of the 32 integer or 32 floating-point registers that comprise the 21264's architecture definition. The register's value becomes a valid part of the CPU's state and becomes visible to programs. This scheme for using temporary registers is fairly standard among out-of-order processors, but the 21264 adds a unique twist: It has a duplicate set of 80 integer registers that are copies of the first 80 integer registers, so the 21264 has a total of 160 integer registers.

The chip's large number of integer registers is one reason it reaches high speeds despite the added complexity of its out-of-order execution. If all four integer units shared the same 80 registers, the register file would need so many read/write ports that its long bus wouldn't be able to keep up with the chip's clock speed. At 1GHz, the cycle time is 1 nanosecond. Electricity isn't fast enough to support an architecture in which four integer units use 80 registers at a cycle time of 1 nanosecond. So Digital created two clusters, each of which has two integer units (one of which is an integer and address unit) and a set of 80 registers. When an instruction changes a register value, the CPU copies the value to a corresponding register in the other register file to keep the files identical. This process requires one clock cycle, but pipelining and reordering can hide that latency. (For a block diagram of the 21264's architecture, see Figure 2.)

Clusters and Caches

The two integer units in each cluster are not identical. One has a multiplier, and the other has special logic to handle five new instructions for motion video processing. The most interesting new instruction (a PERR instruction) replaces nine instructions for motion estimation, which is a critical part of Moving Pictures Experts Group (MPEG) compression and decompression. As a result, the 21264 easily handles MPEG-2 video decoding and AC-3 audio decoding for Digital Versatile Disc (DVD) playback in realtime without requiring special hardware.

The 21264 has two pipelined FPUs that share the 72 floating-point registers. The FPUs execute as many as two instructions per clock cycle. A 600MHz 21264 can sustain 1.2 gigaflops because the integer units can handle two loads or stores per clock cycle for the FPUs.

Digital reorganized the cache hierarchy in the 21264. The chip has a 64KB Level 1 instruction cache and a 64KB Level 1 data cache; each is two-way set-associative. The Level 2 cache is off chip; the 21264 accesses it across a 128-bit backside bus. In contrast, the 21164 has much smaller Level 1 caches (8KB each for instructions and data) and a 96KB integrated Level 2 cache. As Digital is moving the Level 2 cache off chip, vendors such as Intel and AMD are introducing their first CPUs with integrated Level 2 caches. Digital found that large programs frequently miss the 21164's 8KB Level 1 caches, so the older CPU accesses the Level 2 cache more often than necessary. The 21164 takes six clock cycles to access its Level 2 cache, and the chip needs an external Level 3 cache to achieve high performance.

Digital returns to a more conventional approach with the 21264. The chip's large Level 1 caches increase hit rate of the caches. Accessing the caches requires two clock cycles, but that situation is almost unavoidable because the caches are so large and the 21264's clock speed is so fast. When the CPU misses the on-chip caches, it accesses the Level 2 cache via the 128-bit backside bus. This Alpha doesn't need a Level 3 cache.

The first 21264's Level 2 cache will use 200MHz late-write Static RAM (SRAM) chips and will provide 3.2GB per second (GBps) of peak bus bandwidth. That statistic is comparable to the 3.6GBps of peak bus bandwidth that the 450MHz Slot-2 Pentium II will produce. The Pentium II has a 64-bit backside bus to the Level 2 cache. In Slot-2 Xeon systems that Intel recently introduced, the bus runs at the full speed of the CPU core. To counter this Intel advancement, Digital will switch to Dual Data Rate SRAM (DDR-SRAM) chips. DDR-SRAM chips run at 166MHz but transfer data on both edges of a clock signal to achieve a data rate of 333MHz for 5.3GBps of peak bandwidth. Eventually, the 21264's cache bus will run at 250MHz (effectively 500MHz with double clocking) for 8GBps of peak bandwidth. At those speeds, the Level 2 cache will probably keep up with the 21264's 1GHz core.

Buses and Branches

Rather than a system I/O bus, the 21264 has a 64-bit point-to-point channel. The I/O channel is faster than the cache bus; it runs as fast as 333MHz. It connects directly to a Tsunami custom chipset. The Tsunami chipset connects to one or two 32-bit PCI buses that run at 33MHz and to two banks of main memory via a pair of 256-bit buses, each of which runs at 83MHz. In a dual-processor system, the Tsunami chipset connects to the second CPU via an independent 64-bit channel, which runs at 333MHz. (For a depiction of the 21264's system architecture, see Figure 3.)

This bus design is identical to the design AMD licensed for its AMD-K7 processor, which will ship next year. AMD is designing a new CPU interface called Slot A that will use the same physical connectors as Intel's Slot 1 and Single Edge Contact (SEC) cartridge. Instead of using Intel's proprietary P6 bus protocols, Slot A borrows the 21264's bus protocols. Future AMD-K7 and 21264 processors will come in SEC-like cartridges that fit Slot A. AMD-K7 and 21264 motherboards will differ only in their BIOSs.

For AMD, this similarity means that the AMD-K7's bus interface will be faster than Intel's bus interface. For Digital, the similarity means that future 21264 processors will fit lower-cost motherboards, so Alpha system prices will fall. Digital is likely to introduce a 21264PC processor that's similar to the bargain-priced 21164PC. A system that includes the 21264PC and a Slot A motherboard might cost as little as $1500.

The combination of a 333MHz system bus, a high-bandwidth Level 2 cache bus, and a 6-way superscalar core makes the 21264 state of the art. To prevent 21264 bottlenecks, Digital upgraded the CPU's fetching and branch-prediction capabilities. The chip's Level 1 instruction cache has a set predictor that guesses which of the cache's two integer unit register sets the CPU will access next. Then a next-line predictor guesses which cache line within that set the CPU will access. (The cache holds four instructions per line.)

The 21264 uses three branch prediction algorithms. The first predictor focuses on local branches, such as loops. The second predictor keeps a global record of all recent branches. The third predictor decides whether to base the final prediction on the local or global predictor's prediction. The predictors maintain four history tables of previous branches to assist their forecasts. Those tables consume 3.6KB of chip memory. The CPU stores predicted target addresses in the instruction cache; these target addresses consume 6KB. The 21264 provides a lot of space for branch prediction, but Digital claims the 21264's branch prediction capabilities are worth the space because the 21264 mispredicts half as many branches as the 21164, for an overall accuracy rate of about 95 percent.

Complexity Penalty

The 21264 rivals IBM's Power3 as the world's most complex microprocessor. The 21264 has 15.9 million transistors and a 6-way core. The Power3 has 15 million transistors and an 8-way core. The 21264 is making its debut as a six-layer metal, 0.35-micron CMOS process technology. The die size is 300 square millimeters, and the chip burns 60 watts.

By the end of this year, Digital and Samsung plan to migrate the 21264 to a 0.25-micron process that will boost clock speeds to 667MHz and 733MHz and simultaneously shrink the die. In 2000, Samsung will move the 21264 to a 0.18-micron process, the same process on which Intel will manufacture Merced chips in the foundry it bought from Digital. Samsung hopes to beat Intel to the 0.18-micron process. The 21264 will probably break the 1GHz barrier on a die of between 125 square millimeters and 150 square millimeters.

The 21264 currently pays for its complexity in terms of die size, manufacturing cost, and power consumption, but it doesn't pay for its complexity in terms of clock speed. Thanks to the maturity of Alpha compilers and the wealth of native Alpha applications, the 21264 will almost certainly leave Merced in its dust. The question is whether the Alpha will survive the onslaught of IA-64 and maintain its performance lead in the future. Compaq engineers are already working on next-generation CPUs. The company has scheduled the 21364 for release in 2000 and the 21464 for 2001. If Compaq can keep up that pace and doesn't waver in its commitment to the Alpha, the Alpha might become the NT platform that gives Intel a run for its money and consumers the best bang for their buck.

Letters / August 1999

Now you've done it! I've subscribed to the magazine for 3 years, but now I'm really hooked. The articles and columns that Bob Chronister, Mark Russinovich, and Bob Wells write are always satisfying, but Tom R. Halfhill's "The Alpha 21264" (December 1998) captivated me.

The article had a message: The Alpha may be the only RISC chip to succeed long term. RISC versus CISC architecture is an important issue to the future of computing, and the Alpha 21264 offers 64-bit processing in an inexpensive package today. I hope we hear more from Tom Halfhill.

George Rogers Clark
August 6, 1999

While the world waits for Intel's 64-bit Merced chip and Microsoft's 64-bit version of Windows NT, Digital Equipment is offering a sneak preview of the next generation in NT processing. The Alpha 21264 is a 64-bit processor that runs NT. It's one of the fastest chips in the world. And it's available today.

The 21264 is the latest generation of the Alpha microprocessor architecture. Digital expects the 21264 to reach clock speeds of more than 700MHz this year, so this processor upholds the speed demon reputation that the 21164 and 21064 established for Alpha chips.

Alpha is the last RISC architecture for which Microsoft is developing future versions of NT. Microsoft is phasing out NT for MIPS Rx000 chips, and the PowerPC NT never really got off the ground. The only other CPU architecture that runs NT is, of course, Intel x86. Despite Intel's market dominance, the Alpha has one big advantage over the x86: increased performance, especially performance of floating-point tasks. Alpha systems generally cost more than their Intel counterparts, but Alpha systems are faster, and they excel at math-intensive engineering and scientific applications.

To move beyond the performance limitations of the 20-year-old x86, Intel partnered with HP in 1994 to develop a new CPU architecture: Intel Architecture-64 (IA-64). Intel expects systems that use the Merced processor, the first processor to implement IA-64, to ship in mid-2000. But the Merced might not be the fastest chip on the NT market in 2000. Digital says that by the time Merced appears, the 21264 will be running at a clock frequency of 1000MHz (1 gigahertz [GHz]). At that speed, the 21264 will be substantially faster than the Merced according to estimated CPU benchmarks. (For a review of 21264 speeds, see Figure 1.)

Digital said the first 21264 systems would hit the streets in late 1998, so you don't have to wait two years for 64-bit performance. However, the 21264 won't reach its potential until Microsoft ships a 64-bit version of NT for both IA-64 and Alpha chips. (Microsoft hopes to ship the 64-bit NT in 2000.)

Whither RISC?

The race between the 21264 and IA-64 processors is not just a subject of idle gossip. At stake is nothing less than the future of RISC ­for NT and every other operating system (OS).

Outside of the highly specialized embedded-application market, RISC is in retreat. Currently, the most popular RISC architecture for the desktop is the PowerPC chip, which IBM and Motorola produce jointly. But the largest customer for desktop PowerPC chips is Apple, and the Macintosh has only about 4 percent of the PC market share according to International Data Corporation (IDC). In June, IBM and Motorola announced that they are dissolving their 7-year PowerPC partnership and will develop future PowerPC chips separately.

IBM's other RISC architecture, the Power series, is merging with the PowerPC. IBM is phasing out the Power chip as a distinct architecture. The new 64-bit Power3 chip is the first processor that unifies Power and PowerPC technologies.

Battling recent losses, Silicon Graphics is moving away from its MIPS Rx000-series RISC processors. Silicon Graphics canceled its next-generation Rx000 projects and recently spun off the embedded-chip portion of MIPS Technologies as a separate company. Silicon Graphics is developing x86-based systems for NT and porting IRIX to IA-64.

Sun Microsystems is porting Solaris to IA-64. That move has prompted some industry analysts to speculate that the new UltraSPARC-III will be the last major generation of the SPARC family, although Sun claims that the rumors are false.

HP is porting HP-UX to IA-64 as part of its strategy to move away from Precision Architecture-RISC. PA-RISC will gradually exit the market after IA-64 debuts. IA-64 will be backward compatible with PA-RISC.

The Alpha is the fastest RISC chip according to most CPU benchmarks and the only NT alternative to the x86. But the Alpha's future isn't certain because of recent shakeups at Digital. The company sold its chip foundry in Hudson, Massachusetts, to Intel. Despite some misleading news reports, Digital sold only the foundry, not the Alpha. Digital will continue to independently design Alpha processors but will farm out the chips' manufacturing to Intel and other licensees. The two current Alpha-manufacturing licensees are Samsung and Mitsubishi. Digital is also negotiating deals with AMD and IBM Microelectronics. Mitsubishi currently has no plans to manufacture the 21264, although the company continues to provide technical support for the low-cost 21164PC chips it manufactured. Samsung has emerged as the most aggressive Alpha licensee. It recently formed a subsidiary to market Alpha chips and says it will push the 21264 to 1GHz by 2000.

Compaq's acquisition of Digital makes the Alpha's fate more uncertain. Compaq has never owned a CPU architecture, and the company is one of Intel's largest customers for x86 chips. David Jessel, the Alpha's senior product manager, claims that Alpha fans have nothing to worry about. "Compaq has been fully supportive of the Alpha and is continuing to invest in it," Jessel said. To underscore its commitment to the Alpha, Compaq plans to substitute the 21264 for MIPS processors in its high-end Tandem servers.

If the Alpha survives all these transitions, it could seriously challenge IA-64 chips for performance supremacy in the next decade. A technical analysis of the 21264 shows that the Alpha has plenty of room to become more powerful.

Inside the 21264

The 21264 has an innovative design that departs significantly from the 21164's design. The new chip has larger primary caches, additional functional units, more accurate branch prediction, new motion video instructions (MVI), and high bus bandwidth. It executes as many as six instructions per clock cycle and sustains four instructions per clock cycle. In addition, the 21264 is the first Alpha to offer out-of-order execution.

Out-of-order execution is a feature common to many microprocessors. Now that the Alpha offers this feature, Sun's SPARC chips are the only leading CPUs that don't execute instructions out of order. CPUs that run out of order dynamically rearrange a program's instructions at runtime to use the chip's resources efficiently. For example, if an instruction needs an integer unit but all the CPU's integer units are busy, an out-of-order CPU dispatches floating-point instructions to available floating-point units (FPUs) while holding the stalled integer instruction until an integer unit becomes available. When an integer unit becomes available, the CPU releases the stalled instruction. In the same situation, conventional in-order CPUs stall all instructions until the integer unit is free. Out-of-order CPUs always retire results in their original program order.

Out-of-order execution used to be a characteristic of only brainiac processors, CPUs that rely on sophisticated instruction handling, not high clock speeds, to achieve top performance. The complex logic that manages older chips' out-of-order technique rules out high clock speeds. Previous Alpha chips ran at industry-leading speeds because they did not process instructions out of order.

The 21264 breaks from that tradition. Available at 500MHz and 600MHz, it's definitely fast. And it will become faster. Digital says the 21264 will hit 733MHz this year and 1GHz within 2 years. But the 21264 is also a brainiac. It executes instructions out of order, and it does so more deftly than any other processor.

The best way to evaluate the 21264's out-of-order efficiency is to examine the number of instructions it arranges at once. The more instructions an out-of-order CPU holds at one time, the more efficient its processing is because juggling many instructions gives a CPU a broader view of a running program's needs. However, this juggling act requires resources that in-order processing doesn't require: reorder logic, temporary registers to hold values for pending instructions, interlock circuitry to check for dependencies, and logic to retire the results in program order.

Intel's P6 chips (Pentium Pros, Pentium IIs, Celerons, and Pentium II Xeons) juggle as many as 40 instructions simultaneously. HP's PA-8000 handles 56 instructions at once. The 21264 juggles 80 instructions, more instructions than any other processor.

Digital implemented a clever register scheme to make this instruction handling possible. Like most RISC chips, the 21264 has an architectural set of 32 integer registers and 32 floating-point registers, all 64 bits wide. To increase the CPU's capacity for reordering instructions, the 21264 has 48 extra integer registers and 40 extra floating-point registers. Any of these 152 registers can hold temporary values for pending instructions. When an instruction retires, the CPU renames the register that holds the temporary result, so that register represents one of the 32 integer or 32 floating-point registers that comprise the 21264's architecture definition. The register's value becomes a valid part of the CPU's state and becomes visible to programs. This scheme for using temporary registers is fairly standard among out-of-order processors, but the 21264 adds a unique twist: It has a duplicate set of 80 integer registers that are copies of the first 80 integer registers, so the 21264 has a total of 160 integer registers.

The chip's large number of integer registers is one reason it reaches high speeds despite the added complexity of its out-of-order execution. If all four integer units shared the same 80 registers, the register file would need so many read/write ports that its long bus wouldn't be able to keep up with the chip's clock speed. At 1GHz, the cycle time is 1 nanosecond. Electricity isn't fast enough to support an architecture in which four integer units use 80 registers at a cycle time of 1 nanosecond. So Digital created two clusters, each of which has two integer units (one of which is an integer and address unit) and a set of 80 registers. When an instruction changes a register value, the CPU copies the value to a corresponding register in the other register file to keep the files identical. This process requires one clock cycle, but pipelining and reordering can hide that latency. (For a block diagram of the 21264's architecture, see Figure 2.)

Clusters and Caches

The two integer units in each cluster are not identical. One has a multiplier, and the other has special logic to handle five new instructions for motion video processing. The most interesting new instruction (a PERR instruction) replaces nine instructions for motion estimation, which is a critical part of Moving Pictures Experts Group (MPEG) compression and decompression. As a result, the 21264 easily handles MPEG-2 video decoding and AC-3 audio decoding for Digital Versatile Disc (DVD) playback in realtime without requiring special hardware.

The 21264 has two pipelined FPUs that share the 72 floating-point registers. The FPUs execute as many as two instructions per clock cycle. A 600MHz 21264 can sustain 1.2 gigaflops because the integer units can handle two loads or stores per clock cycle for the FPUs.

Digital reorganized the cache hierarchy in the 21264. The chip has a 64KB Level 1 instruction cache and a 64KB Level 1 data cache; each is two-way set-associative. The Level 2 cache is off chip; the 21264 accesses it across a 128-bit backside bus. In contrast, the 21164 has much smaller Level 1 caches (8KB each for instructions and data) and a 96KB integrated Level 2 cache. As Digital is moving the Level 2 cache off chip, vendors such as Intel and AMD are introducing their first CPUs with integrated Level 2 caches. Digital found that large programs frequently miss the 21164's 8KB Level 1 caches, so the older CPU accesses the Level 2 cache more often than necessary. The 21164 takes six clock cycles to access its Level 2 cache, and the chip needs an external Level 3 cache to achieve high performance.

Digital returns to a more conventional approach with the 21264. The chip's large Level 1 caches increase hit rate of the caches. Accessing the caches requires two clock cycles, but that situation is almost unavoidable because the caches are so large and the 21264's clock speed is so fast. When the CPU misses the on-chip caches, it accesses the Level 2 cache via the 128-bit backside bus. This Alpha doesn't need a Level 3 cache.

The first 21264's Level 2 cache will use 200MHz late-write Static RAM (SRAM) chips and will provide 3.2GB per second (GBps) of peak bus bandwidth. That statistic is comparable to the 3.6GBps of peak bus bandwidth that the 450MHz Slot-2 Pentium II will produce. The Pentium II has a 64-bit backside bus to the Level 2 cache. In Slot-2 Xeon systems that Intel recently introduced, the bus runs at the full speed of the CPU core. To counter this Intel advancement, Digital will switch to Dual Data Rate SRAM (DDR-SRAM) chips. DDR-SRAM chips run at 166MHz but transfer data on both edges of a clock signal to achieve a data rate of 333MHz for 5.3GBps of peak bandwidth. Eventually, the 21264's cache bus will run at 250MHz (effectively 500MHz with double clocking) for 8GBps of peak bandwidth. At those speeds, the Level 2 cache will probably keep up with the 21264's 1GHz core.

Buses and Branches

Rather than a system I/O bus, the 21264 has a 64-bit point-to-point channel. The I/O channel is faster than the cache bus; it runs as fast as 333MHz. It connects directly to a Tsunami custom chipset. The Tsunami chipset connects to one or two 32-bit PCI buses that run at 33MHz and to two banks of main memory via a pair of 256-bit buses, each of which runs at 83MHz. In a dual-processor system, the Tsunami chipset connects to the second CPU via an independent 64-bit channel, which runs at 333MHz. (For a depiction of the 21264's system architecture, see Figure 3.)

This bus design is identical to the design AMD licensed for its AMD-K7 processor, which will ship next year. AMD is designing a new CPU interface called Slot A that will use the same physical connectors as Intel's Slot 1 and Single Edge Contact (SEC) cartridge. Instead of using Intel's proprietary P6 bus protocols, Slot A borrows the 21264's bus protocols. Future AMD-K7 and 21264 processors will come in SEC-like cartridges that fit Slot A. AMD-K7 and 21264 motherboards will differ only in their BIOSs.

For AMD, this similarity means that the AMD-K7's bus interface will be faster than Intel's bus interface. For Digital, the similarity means that future 21264 processors will fit lower-cost motherboards, so Alpha system prices will fall. Digital is likely to introduce a 21264PC processor that's similar to the bargain-priced 21164PC. A system that includes the 21264PC and a Slot A motherboard might cost as little as $1500.

The combination of a 333MHz system bus, a high-bandwidth Level 2 cache bus, and a 6-way superscalar core makes the 21264 state of the art. To prevent 21264 bottlenecks, Digital upgraded the CPU's fetching and branch-prediction capabilities. The chip's Level 1 instruction cache has a set predictor that guesses which of the cache's two integer unit register sets the CPU will access next. Samsung hopes to beat Intel to the 0.18-micron process. The 21264 will probably break the 1GHz barrier on a die of between 125 square millimeters and 150 square millimeters.

sentences.zh: 作为摆脱 Precision Architecture-RISC 战略的一部分，HP 正在将 HP-UX 移植到 IA-64。

sentences.en: PA-RISC will gradually exit the market after IA-64 debuts.
sentences.zh: PA-RISC将在IA-64推出后逐渐退出市场。

sentences.en: IA-64 will be backward compatible with PA-RISC.
sentences.zh: IA-64 将向后兼容 PA-RISC。

sentences.en: The Alpha is the fastest RISC chip according to most CPU benchmarks and the only NT alternative to the x86.
sentences.zh: 根据大多数 CPU 基准测试，Alpha 是最快的 RISC 芯片，也是 x86 的唯一 NT 替代品。

sentences.en: But the Alpha's future isn't certain because of recent shakeups at Digital.
sentences.zh: 但由于 Digital 最近的重组，Alpha 的未来并不确定。

sentences.en: The company sold its chip foundry in Hudson, Massachusetts, to Intel.
sentences.zh: 该公司将其位于马萨诸塞州哈德逊的芯片代工厂出售给英特尔。

sentences.en: Despite some misleading news reports, Digital sold only the foundry, not the Alpha.
sentences.zh: 尽管有一些误导性的新闻报道，Digital 只出售了代工厂，而不是 Alpha。

sentences.en: Digital will continue to independently design Alpha processors but will farm out the chips' manufacturing to Intel and other licensees.
sentences.zh: Digital 将继续独立设计 Alpha 处理器，但会将芯片的制造外包给英特尔和其他授权商。

sentences.en: The two current Alpha-manufacturing licensees are Samsung and Mitsubishi.
sentences.zh: 当前的两家 Alpha 制造授权商是三星和三菱。

sentences.en: Digital is also negotiating deals with AMD and IBM Microelectronics.
sentences.zh: Digital 还正在与 AMD 和 IBM 微电子公司进行交易谈判。

sentences.en: Mitsubishi currently has no plans to manufacture the 21264, although the company continues to provide technical support for the low-cost 21164PC chips it manufactured.
sentences.zh: 三菱目前没有计划生产21264，尽管该公司继续为其生产的低成本21164PC芯片提供技术支持。

sentences.en: Samsung has emerged as the most aggressive Alpha licensee.
sentences.zh: 三星已成为最积极的 Alpha 授权商。

sentences.en: It recently formed a subsidiary to market Alpha chips and says it will push the 21264 to 1GHz by 2000.
sentences.zh: 它最近成立了一家子公司来销售 Alpha 芯片，并表示到 2000 年将把 21264 推向 1GHz。

sentences.en: Compaq's acquisition of Digital makes the Alpha's fate more uncertain.
sentences.zh: 康柏对Digital的收购让Alpha的命运更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Compaq has never owned a CPU architecture, and the company is one of Intel's largest customers for x86 chips.
sentences.zh: 康柏从未拥有过 CPU 架构，该公司是英特尔 x86 芯片的最大客户之一。

sentences.en: David Jessel, the Alpha's senior product manager, claims that Alpha fans have nothing to worry about.
sentences.zh: Alpha 的高级产品经理 David Jessel 声称 Alpha 粉丝无需担心。

sentences.en: "Compaq has been fully supportive of the Alpha and is continuing to invest in it," Jessel said.
sentences.zh: “康柏一直全力支持 Alpha，并将继续对其进行投资，”Jessel 说。

sentences.en: To underscore its commitment to the Alpha, Compaq plans to substitute the 21264 for MIPS processors in its high-end Tandem servers.
sentences.zh: 为了强调其对 Alpha 的承诺，康柏计划在其高端 Tandem 服务器中用 21264 替代 MIPS 处理器。

sentences.en: If the Alpha survives all these transitions, it could seriously challenge IA-64 chips for performance supremacy in the next decade.
sentences.zh: 如果 Alpha 在所有这些转变中幸存下来，它可能会在未来十年严重挑战 IA-64 芯片的性能霸主地位。

sentences.en: A technical analysis of the 21264 shows that the Alpha has plenty of room to become more powerful.
sentences.zh: 对 21264 的技术分析表明 Alpha 有足够的空间变得更强大。

sentences.en: Inside the 21264 The 21264 has an innovative design that departs significantly from the 21164's design.
sentences.zh: 21264 内部 21264 具有与 21164 设计显着不同的创新设计。

sentences.en: The new chip has larger primary caches, additional functional units, more accurate branch prediction, new motion video instructions (MVI), and high bus bandwidth.
sentences.zh: 新芯片拥有更大的主缓存、额外的功能单元、更准确的分支预测、新的运动视频指令（MVI）和高总线带宽。

sentences.en: It executes as many as six instructions per clock cycle and sustains four instructions per clock cycle.
sentences.zh: 它每个时钟周期执行多达六个指令，并且每个时钟周期维持四个指令。

sentences.en: In addition, the 21264 is the first Alpha to offer out-of-order execution.
sentences.zh: 此外，21264 是第一个提供乱序执行的 Alpha。

sentences.en: Out-of-order execution is a feature common to many microprocessors.
sentences.zh: 乱序执行是许多微处理器的共同特征。

sentences.en: Now that the Alpha offers this feature, Sun's SPARC chips are the only leading CPUs that don't execute instructions out of order.
sentences.zh: 既然 Alpha 提供了此功能，Sun 的 SPARC 芯片是唯一不会乱序执行指令的领先 CPU。

sentences.en: CPUs that run out of order dynamically rearrange a program's instructions at runtime to use the chip's resources efficiently.
sentences.zh: 无序运行的 CPU 在运行时动态地重新排列程序的指令，以有效地使用芯片的资源。

sentences.en: For example, if an instruction needs an integer unit but all the CPU's integer units are busy, an out-of-order CPU dispatches floating-point instructions to available floating-point units (FPUs) while holding the stalled integer instruction until an integer unit becomes available.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果一条指令需要一个整数单元，但所有 CPU 的整数单元都忙，则无序 CPU 会将浮点指令分派到可用的浮点单元 (FPU)，同时保留停滞的整数指令，直到整数单元可用。

sentences.en: When an integer unit becomes available, the CPU releases the stalled instruction.
sentences.zh: 当整数单元可用时，CPU 释放停滞的指令。

sentences.en: In the same situation, conventional in-order CPUs stall all instructions until the integer unit is free.
sentences.zh: 在相同的情况下，传统的有序 CPU 会停止所有指令，直到整数单元空闲为止。

sentences.en: Out-of-order CPUs always retire results in their original program order.
sentences.zh: 乱序 CPU 总是按其原始程序顺序废弃结果。

sentences.en: Out-of-order execution used to be a characteristic of only brainiac processors, CPUs that rely on sophisticated instruction handling, not high clock speeds, to achieve top performance.
sentences.zh: 乱序执行曾经是只有 Brainiac 处理器的特征，这些 CPU 依靠复杂的指令处理而不是高时钟速度来实现最高性能。

sentences.en: The complex logic that manages older chips' out-of-order technique rules out high clock speeds.
sentences.zh: 管理旧芯片乱序技术的复杂逻辑排除了高时钟速度。

sentences.en: Previous Alpha chips ran at industry-leading speeds because they did not process instructions out of order.
sentences.zh: 以前的 Alpha 芯片以行业领先的速度运行，因为它们不会乱序处理指令。

sentences.en: The 21264 breaks from that tradition.
sentences.zh: 21264 打破了这一传统。

sentences.en: Available at 500MHz and 600MHz, it's definitely fast.
sentences.zh: 提供 500MHz 和 600MHz 频率，速度绝对很快。

sentences.en: And it will become faster.
sentences.zh: 而且会变得更快。

sentences.en: Digital says the 21264 will hit 733MHz this year and 1GHz within 2 years.
sentences.zh: Digital表示，21264今年将达到733MHz，并在两年内达到1GHz。

sentences.en: But the 21264 is also a brainiac.
sentences.zh: 但 21264 也是一个天才。

sentences.en: It executes instructions out of order, and it does so more deftly than any other processor.
sentences.zh: 它不按顺序执行指令，而且比任何其他处理器都更灵活地执行指令。

sentences.en: The best way to evaluate the 21264's out-of-order efficiency is to examine the number of instructions it arranges at once.
sentences.zh: 评估21264乱序效率的最佳方法是检查它一次排列的指令数量。

sentences.en: The more instructions an out-of-order CPU holds at one time, the more efficient its processing is because juggling many instructions gives a CPU a broader view of a running program's needs.
sentences.zh: 无序 CPU 一次保存的指令越多，其处理效率就越高，因为同时处理许多指令可以让 CPU 对正在运行的程序的需求有更广泛的了解。

sentences.en: However, this juggling act requires resources that in-order processing doesn't require: reorder logic, temporary registers to hold values for pending instructions, interlock circuitry to check for dependencies, and logic to retire the results in program order.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种杂耍行为需要按顺序处理不需要的资源：重新排序逻辑、用于保存待处理指令的值的临时寄存器、用于检查依赖性的互锁电路以及用于按程序顺序废弃结果的逻辑。

sentences.en: Intel's P6 chips (Pentium Pros, Pentium IIs, Celerons, and Pentium II Xeons) juggle as many as 40 instructions simultaneously.
sentences.zh: Intel 的 P6 芯片（Pentium Pro、Pentium II、Celeron 和 Pentium II Xeon）可同时处理多达 40 条指令。

sentences.en: HP's PA-8000 handles 56 instructions at once.
sentences.zh: HP 的 PA-8000 可以同时处理 56 条指令。

sentences.en: The 21264 juggles 80 instructions, more instructions than any other processor.
sentences.zh: 21264 可处理 80 条指令，比任何其他处理器都多。

sentences.en: Digital implemented a clever register scheme to make this instruction handling possible.
sentences.zh: Digital 实现了一种巧妙的寄存器方案，使这种指令处理成为可能。

sentences.en: Like most RISC chips, the 21264 has an architectural set of 32 integer registers and 32 floating-point registers, all 64 bits wide.
sentences.zh: 与大多数 RISC 芯片一样，21264 具有 32 个整数寄存器和 32 个浮点寄存器的架构集，全部为 64 位宽。

sentences.en: To increase the CPU's capacity for reordering instructions, the 21264 has 48 extra integer registers and 40 extra floating-point registers.
sentences.zh: 为了增加CPU重新排序指令的能力，21264有48个额外的整数寄存器和40个额外的浮点寄存器。

sentences.en: Any of these 152 registers can hold temporary values for pending instructions.
sentences.zh: 这 152 个寄存器中的任何一个都可以保存待处理指令的临时值。

sentences.en: When an instruction retires, the CPU renames the register that holds the temporary result, so that register represents one of the 32 integer or 32 floating-point registers that comprise the 21264's architecture definition.
sentences.zh: 当指令退出时，CPU 会重命名保存临时结果的寄存器，以便该寄存器代表构成 21264 架构定义的 32 个整数或 32 个浮点寄存器之一。

sentences.en: The register's value becomes a valid part of the CPU's state and becomes visible to programs.
sentences.zh: 寄存器的值成为CPU状态的有效部分并且对程序可见。

sentences.en: This scheme for using temporary registers is fairly standard among out-of-order processors, but the 21264 adds a unique twist: It has a duplicate set of 80 integer registers that are copies of the first 80 integer registers, so the 21264 has a total of 160 integer registers.
sentences.zh: 这种使用临时寄存器的方案在乱序处理器中相当标准，但 21264 增加了一个独特的变化：它有一组 80 个整数寄存器的副本，这些寄存器是前 80 个整数寄存器的副本，因此 21264 总共有 160 个整数寄存器。

sentences.en: The chip's large number of integer registers is one reason it reaches high speeds despite the added complexity of its out-of-order execution.
sentences.zh: 该芯片的大量整数寄存器是其达到高速的原因之一，尽管其乱序执行增加了复杂性。

sentences.en: If all four integer units shared the same 80 registers, the register file would need so many read/write ports that its long bus wouldn't be able to keep up with the chip's clock speed.
sentences.zh: 如果所有四个整数单元共享相同的 80 个寄存器，则寄存器文件将需要如此多的读/写端口，以至于其长总线将无法跟上芯片的时钟速度。

sentences.en: At 1GHz, the cycle time is 1 nanosecond.
sentences.zh: 在 1GHz 时，周期时间为 1 纳秒。

sentences.en: Electricity isn't fast enough to support an architecture in which four integer units use 80 registers at a cycle time of 1 nanosecond.
sentences.zh: 电力的速度还不够快，无法支持四个整数单元以 1 纳秒的周期时间使用 80 个寄存器的架构。

sentences.en: So Digital created two clusters, each of which has two integer units (one of which is an integer and address unit) and a set of 80 registers.
sentences.zh: 因此Digital创建了两个集群，每个集群有两个整数单元（其中一个是整数和地址单元）和一组80个寄存器。

sentences.en: When an instruction changes a register value, the CPU copies the value to a corresponding register in the other register file to keep the files identical.
sentences.zh: 当指令更改寄存器值时，CPU 会将该值复制到另一个寄存器文件中的相应寄存器，以保持文件相同。

sentences.en: This process requires one clock cycle, but pipelining and reordering can hide that latency.
sentences.zh: 这一过程需要一个时钟周期，但流水线和重新排序可以隐藏该延迟。

sentences.en: (For a block diagram of the 21264's architecture, see Figure 2.)
sentences.zh: （有关 21264 架构的框图，请参见图 2。）

sentences.en: Clusters and Caches The two integer units in each cluster are not identical.
sentences.zh: 簇和缓存 每个簇中的两个整数单元不相同。

sentences.en: One has a multiplier, and the other has special logic to handle five new instructions for motion video processing.
sentences.zh: 一个具有乘法器，另一个具有特殊逻辑来处理用于运动视频处理的五个新指令。

sentences.en: The most interesting new instruction (a PERR instruction) replaces nine instructions for motion estimation, which is a critical part of Moving Pictures Experts Group (MPEG) compression and decompression.
sentences.zh: 最有趣的新指令（PERR 指令）取代了九个运动估计指令，这是运动图像专家组 (MPEG) 压缩和解压缩的关键部分。

sentences.en: As a result, the 21264 easily handles MPEG-2 video decoding and AC-3 audio decoding for Digital Versatile Disc (DVD) playback in realtime without requiring special hardware.
sentences.zh: 因此，21264 可以轻松处理实时数字多功能光盘 (DVD) 播放的 MPEG-2 视频解码和 AC-3 音频解码，无需特殊硬件。

sentences.en: The 21264 has two pipelined FPUs that share the 72 floating-point registers.
sentences.zh: 21264 有两个共享 72 个浮点寄存器的流水线 FPU。

sentences.en: The FPUs execute as many as two instructions per clock cycle.
sentences.zh: FPU 每个时钟周期执行多达两条指令。

sentences.en: A 600MHz 21264 can sustain 1.2 gigaflops because the integer units can handle two loads or stores per clock cycle for the FPUs.
sentences.zh: 600MHz 21264 可以维持 1.2 gigaflops，因为整数单元可以在 FPU 的每个时钟周期处理两次加载或存储。

sentences.en: Digital reorganized the cache hierarchy in the 21264.
sentences.zh: Digital 重新组织了 21264 中的缓存层次结构。

sentences.en: The chip has a 64KB Level 1 instruction cache and a 64KB Level 1 data cache; each is two-way set-associative.
sentences.zh: 该芯片具有64KB 1级指令缓存和64KB 1级数据缓存；每个都是双向集合关联的。

sentences.en: The Level 2 cache is off chip; the 21264 accesses it across a 128-bit backside bus.
sentences.zh: 二级缓存位于片外； 21264 通过 128 位后端总线访问它。

sentences.en: In contrast, the 21164 has much smaller Level 1 caches (8KB each for instructions and data) and a 96KB integrated Level 2 cache.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，21164 具有小得多的一级缓存（指令和数据各 8KB）和 96KB 集成二级缓存。

sentences.en: As Digital is moving the Level 2 cache off chip, vendors such as Intel and AMD are introducing their first CPUs with integrated Level 2 caches.
sentences.zh: 随着 Digital 将二级缓存移出芯片，英特尔和 AMD 等供应商正在推出其首款集成二级缓存的 CPU。

sentences.en: Digital found that large programs frequently miss the 21164's 8KB Level 1 caches, so the older CPU accesses the Level 2 cache more often than necessary.
sentences.zh: Digital 发现大型程序经常会错过 21164 的 8KB 一级缓存，因此较旧的 CPU 访问二级缓存的频率超出了必要的范围。

sentences.en: The 21164 takes six clock cycles to access its Level 2 cache, and the chip needs an external Level 3 cache to achieve high performance.
sentences.zh: 21164需要六个时钟周期来访问其二级缓存，并且该芯片需要外部三级缓存才能实现高性能。

sentences.en: Digital returns to a more conventional approach with the 21264.
sentences.zh: 21264 使数字回归到更传统的方法。

sentences.en: The chip's large Level 1 caches increase hit rate of the caches.
sentences.zh: 该芯片拥有大容量的一级缓存，提高了缓存的命中率。

sentences.en: Accessing the caches requires two clock cycles, but that situation is almost unavoidable because the caches are so large and the 21264's clock speed is so fast.
sentences.zh: 访问高速缓存需要两个时钟周期，但这种情况几乎是不可避免的，因为高速缓存太大，而21264的时钟速度又太快。

sentences.en: When the CPU misses the on-chip caches, it accesses the Level 2 cache via the 128-bit backside bus.
sentences.zh: 当CPU错过片上缓存时，它通过128位后端总线访问二级缓存。

sentences.en: This Alpha doesn't need a Level 3 cache.
sentences.zh: 此 Alpha 不需要 3 级缓存。

sentences.en: The first 21264's Level 2 cache will use 200MHz late-write Static RAM (SRAM) chips and will provide 3.2GB per second (GBps) of peak bus bandwidth.
sentences.zh: 第一个 21264 的 2 级高速缓存将使用 200MHz 后期写入静态 RAM (SRAM) 芯片，并将提供每秒 3.2GB (GBps) 的峰值总线带宽。

sentences.en: That statistic is comparable to the 3.6GBps of peak bus bandwidth that the 450MHz Slot-2 Pentium II will produce.
sentences.zh: 该统计数据与 450MHz Slot-2 Pentium II 产生的 3.6GBps 峰值总线带宽相当。

sentences.en: The Pentium II has a 64-bit backside bus to the Level 2 cache.
sentences.zh: Pentium II 有一个连接 2 级高速缓存的 64 位后端总线。

sentences.en: In Slot-2 Xeon systems that Intel recently introduced, the bus runs at the full speed of the CPU core.
sentences.zh: 在英特尔最近推出的 Slot-2 Xeon 系统中，总线以 CPU 内核的全速运行。

sentences.en: To counter this Intel advancement, Digital will switch to Dual Data Rate SRAM (DDR-SRAM) chips.
sentences.zh: 为了对抗英特尔的这一进步，Digital 将改用双数据速率 SRAM (DDR-SRAM) 芯片。

sentences.en: DDR-SRAM chips run at 166MHz but transfer data on both edges of a clock signal to achieve a data rate of 333MHz for 5.3GBps of peak bandwidth.
sentences.zh: DDR-SRAM 芯片以 166MHz 运行，但在时钟信号的两个边沿上传输数据，以实现 333MHz 的数据速率和 5.3GBps 的峰值带宽。

sentences.en: Eventually, the 21264's cache bus will run at 250MHz (effectively 500MHz with double clocking) for 8GBps of peak bandwidth.
sentences.zh: 最终，21264 的缓存总线将以 250MHz 运行（双时钟实际上为 500MHz），峰值带宽为 8GBps。

sentences.en: At those speeds, the Level 2 cache will probably keep up with the 21264's 1GHz core.
sentences.zh: 在这些速度下，二级缓存可能会跟上 21264 的 1GHz 核心。

sentences.en: Buses and Branches Rather than a system I/O bus, the 21264 has a 64-bit point-to-point channel.
sentences.zh: 总线和分支 21264 不是系统 I/O 总线，而是 64 位点对点通道。

sentences.en: The I/O channel is faster than the cache bus; it runs as fast as 333MHz.
sentences.zh: I/O通道比缓存总线更快；它的运行速度高达 333MHz。

sentences.en: It connects directly to a Tsunami custom chipset.
sentences.zh: 它直接连接到 Tsunami 定制芯片组。

sentences.en: The Tsunami chipset connects to one or two 32-bit PCI buses that run at 33MHz and to two banks of main memory via a pair of 256-bit buses, each of which runs at 83MHz.
sentences.zh: Tsunami 芯片组连接到一个或两个以 33MHz 运行的 32 位 PCI 总线，并通过一对 256 位总线（每条以 83MHz 运行）连接到两组主存储器。

sentences.en: In a dual-processor system, the Tsunami chipset connects to the second CPU via an independent 64-bit channel, which runs at 333MHz.
sentences.zh: 在双处理器系统中，Tsunami 芯片组通过独立的 64 位通道连接到第二个 CPU，该通道的运行频率为 333MHz。

sentences.en: (For a depiction of the 21264's system architecture, see Figure 3.)
sentences.zh: （有关 21264 系统架构的描述，请参见图 3。）

sentences.en: This bus design is identical to the design AMD licensed for its AMD-K7 processor, which will ship next year.
sentences.zh: 该总线设计与 AMD 为其 AMD-K7 处理器授权的设计相同，该处理器将于明年发货。

sentences.en: AMD is designing a new CPU interface called Slot A that will use the same physical connectors as Intel's Slot 1 and Single Edge Contact (SEC) cartridge.
sentences.zh: AMD 正在设计一种名为 Slot A 的新 CPU 接口，该接口将使用与 Intel 的 Slot 1 和单边接触 (SEC) 盒相同的物理连接器。

sentences.en: Instead of using Intel's proprietary P6 bus protocols, Slot A borrows the 21264's bus protocols.
sentences.zh: Slot A 没有使用 Intel 专有的 P6 总线协议，而是借用了 21264 的总线协议。

sentences.en: Future AMD-K7 and 21264 processors will come in SEC-like cartridges that fit Slot A.
sentences.zh: 未来的 AMD-K7 和 21264 处理器将采用适合插槽 A 的类似 SEC 的卡式盒。

sentences.en: AMD-K7 and 21264 motherboards will differ only in their BIOSs.
sentences.zh: AMD-K7 和 21264 主板仅在 BIOS 上有所不同。

sentences.en: For AMD, this similarity means that the AMD-K7's bus interface will be faster than Intel's bus interface.
sentences.zh: 对于AMD来说，这种相似性意味着AMD-K7的总线接口将比Intel的总线接口更快。

sentences.en: For Digital, the similarity means that future 21264 processors will fit lower-cost motherboards, so Alpha system prices will fall.
sentences.zh: 对于Digital来说，这种相似性意味着未来的21264处理器将适合更低成本的主板，因此Alpha系统的价格将会下降。

sentences.en: Digital is likely to introduce a 21264PC processor that's similar to the bargain-priced 21164PC.
sentences.zh: Digital 可能会推出一款 21264PC 处理器，与低价的 21164PC 类似。

sentences.en: A system that includes the 21264PC and a Slot A motherboard might cost as little as $1500.
sentences.zh: 包含 21264PC 和 A 插槽主板的系统成本可能低至 1500 美元。

sentences.en: The combination of a 333MHz system bus, a high-bandwidth Level 2 cache bus, and a 6-way superscalar core makes the 21264 state of the art.
sentences.zh: 333MHz 系统总线、高带宽 2 级缓存总线和 6 路超标量内核的组合使 21264 成为最先进的技术。

sentences.en: To prevent 21264 bottlenecks, Digital upgraded the CPU's fetching and branch-prediction capabilities.
sentences.zh: 为了防止21264瓶颈，Digital升级了CPU的读取和分支预测功能。

sentences.en: The chip's Level 1 instruction cache has a set predictor that guesses which of the cache's two integer unit register sets the CPU will access next.
sentences.zh: 该芯片的一级指令高速缓存有一个集合预测器，可以猜测 CPU 接下来将访问高速缓存的两个整数单元寄存器集中的哪一个。

sentences.en: Then a next-line predictor guesses which cache line within that set the CPU will access.
sentences.zh: 然后，下一行预测器会猜测 CPU 将访问该组中的哪个高速缓存行。

sentences.en: (The cache holds four instructions per line.)
sentences.zh: （缓存每行保存四个指令。）

sentences.en: The 21264 uses three branch prediction algorithms.
sentences.zh: 21264 使用三种分支预测算法。

sentences.en: The first predictor focuses on local branches, such as loops.
sentences.zh: 第一个预测器关注局部分支，例如循环。

sentences.en: The second predictor keeps a global record of all recent branches.
sentences.zh: 第二个预测器保留所有最近分支的全局记录。

sentences.en: The third predictor decides whether to base the final prediction on the local or global predictor's prediction.
sentences.zh: 第三个预测器决定最终预测是否基于局部预测器的预测或全局预测器的预测。

sentences.en: The predictors maintain four history tables of previous branches to assist their forecasts.
sentences.zh: 预测器维护先前分支的四个历史表以协助他们的预测。

sentences.en: Those tables consume 3.6KB of chip memory.
sentences.zh: 这些表消耗 3.6KB 的芯片内存。

sentences.en: The CPU stores predicted target addresses in the instruction cache; these target addresses consume 6KB.
sentences.zh: CPU将预测的目标地址存储在指令缓存中；这些目标地址消耗 6KB。

sentences.en: The 21264 provides a lot of space for branch prediction, but Digital claims the 21264's branch prediction capabilities are worth the space because the 21264 mispredicts half as many branches as the 21164, for an overall accuracy rate of about 95 percent.
sentences.zh: 21264 为分支预测提供了很大的空间，但 Digital 声称 21264 的分支预测功能是值得的，因为 21264 错误预测的分支数量是 21164 的一半，总体准确率约为 95%。

sentences.en: Complexity Penalty The 21264 rivals IBM's Power3 as the world's most complex microprocessor.
sentences.zh: 复杂性损失 21264 可以与 IBM 的 Power3 媲美，成为世界上最复杂的微处理器。

sentences.en: The 21264 has 15.9 million transistors and a 6-way core.
sentences.zh: 21264有1590万个晶体管和一个6路核心。

sentences.en: The Power3 has 15 million transistors and an 8-way core.
sentences.zh: Power3拥有1500万个晶体管和一个8路核心。

sentences.en: The 21264 is making its debut as a six-layer metal, 0.35-micron CMOS process technology.
sentences.zh: 21264 作为六层金属、0.35 微米 CMOS 工艺技术首次亮相。

sentences.en: The die size is 300 square millimeters, and the chip burns 60 watts.
sentences.zh: 芯片尺寸为300平方毫米，芯片功耗为60瓦。

sentences.en: By the end of this year, Digital and Samsung plan to migrate the 21264 to a 0.25-micron process that will boost clock speeds to 667MHz and 733MHz and simultaneously shrink the die.
sentences.zh: 到今年年底，Digital 和三星计划将 21264 迁移到 0.25 微米工艺，将时钟速度提高到 667MHz 和 733MHz，同时缩小芯片尺寸。

sentences.en: In 2000, Samsung will move the 21264 to a 0.18-micron process, the same process on which Intel will manufacture Merced chips in the foundry it bought from Digital.
sentences.zh: 2000 年，三星将把 21264 转为 0.18 微米工艺，与英特尔在从 Digital 购买的代工厂中生产 Merced 芯片的工艺相同。

sentences.en: Samsung hopes to beat Intel to the 0.18-micron process.
sentences.zh: 三星希望在0.18微米工艺上击败英特尔。

sentences.en: The 21264 will probably break the 1GHz barrier on a die of between 125 square millimeters and 150 square millimeters.
sentences.zh: 21264 可能会在 125 平方毫米到 150 平方毫米的芯片上突破 1GHz 的障碍。

sentences.en: The 21264 currently pays for its complexity in terms of die size, manufacturing cost, and power consumption, but it doesn't pay for its complexity in terms of clock speed.
sentences.zh: 21264 目前在芯片尺寸、制造成本和功耗方面弥补了其复杂性，但在时钟速度方面却没有弥补其复杂性。

sentences.en: Thanks to the maturity of Alpha compilers and the wealth of native Alpha applications, the 21264 will almost certainly leave Merced in its dust.
sentences.zh: 由于 Alpha 编译器的成熟和本地 Alpha 应用程序的丰富，21264 几乎肯定会让 Merced 望尘莫及。

sentences.en: The question is whether the Alpha will survive the onslaught of IA-64 and maintain its performance lead in the future.
sentences.zh: 问题是 Alpha 能否在 IA-64 的攻击下幸存下来并在未来保持其性能领先地位。

sentences.en: Compaq engineers are already working on next-generation CPUs.
sentences.zh: 康柏工程师已经开始研发下一代 CPU。

sentences.en: The company has scheduled the 21364 for release in 2000 and the 21464 for 2001.
sentences.zh: 该公司计划于 2000 年发布 21364，并于 2001 年发布 21464。

sentences.en: If Compaq can keep up that pace and doesn't waver in its commitment to the Alpha, the Alpha might become the NT platform that gives Intel a run for its money and consumers the best bang for their buck.
sentences.zh: 如果康柏能够保持这一步伐并且毫不动摇对 Alpha 的承诺，Alpha 可能会成为与英特尔竞争的 NT 平台，并为消费者带来最大的实惠。

sentences.zh: 哪里可以找到 Digital Maynard, MA 510-490-4753 http://www.digital.com/semiconductor/alpha/alpha.htm 图 1：Digital 预测 Alpha 21264 将在 2000 年达到 1 GHz (1000 MHz)。

sentences.zh: 图 3：Tsunami 芯片组是基于 21264 的系统的关键组件。

sentences.zh: 来信/1999 年 8 月 现在你已经做到了！

sentences.en: I've subscribed to the magazine for 3 years, but now I'm really hooked.
sentences.zh: 我订阅这本杂志已经三年了，但现在我真的被迷住了。

sentences.en: The articles and columns that Bob Chronister, Mark Russinovich, and Bob Wells write are always satisfying, but Tom R.

sentences.en: Halfhill's "The Alpha 21264" (December 1998) captivated me.
sentences.zh: Halfhill 的“The Alpha 21264”（1998 年 12 月）让我着迷。

sentences.en: The article had a message: The Alpha may be the only RISC chip to succeed long term.
sentences.zh: 文章传达了这样一个信息：Alpha 可能是唯一能够长期成功的 RISC 芯片。

sentences.en: RISC versus CISC architecture is an important issue to the future of computing, and the Alpha 21264 offers 64-bit processing in an inexpensive package today.
sentences.zh: RISC 与 CISC 架构是未来计算的一个重要问题，而 Alpha 21264 目前以便宜的封装提供 64 位处理。

sentences.en: I hope we hear more from Tom Halfhill.

blocks.html_en: While the world waits for Intel's 64-bit Merced chip and Microsoft's 64-bit version of Windows NT, Digital Equipment is offering a sneak preview of the next generation in NT processing. The Alpha 21264 is a 64-bit processor that runs NT. It's one of the fastest chips in the world. And it's available today.

sentences.en: While the world waits for Intel's 64-bit Merced chip and Microsoft's 64-bit version of Windows NT, Digital Equipment is offering a sneak preview of the next generation in NT processing.
sentences.zh: 当全世界都在等待英特尔的 64 位 Merced 芯片和微软的 64 位版本的 Windows NT 时，Digital Equipment 正在提供下一代 NT 处理的先睹为快。

sentences.en: The Alpha 21264 is a 64-bit processor that runs NT.
sentences.zh: Alpha 21264 是运行 NT 的 64 位处理器。

sentences.en: It's one of the fastest chips in the world.
sentences.zh: 它是世界上最快的芯片之一。

sentences.en: And it's available today.
sentences.zh: 今天就可以使用了。

blocks.html_en: The 21264 is the latest generation of the Alpha microprocessor architecture. Digital expects the 21264 to reach clock speeds of more than 700MHz this year, so this processor upholds the speed demon reputation that the 21164 and 21064 established for Alpha chips.

sentences.en: The 21264 is the latest generation of the Alpha microprocessor architecture.
sentences.zh: 21264 是最新一代的 Alpha 微处理器架构。

sentences.en: Digital expects the 21264 to reach clock speeds of more than 700MHz this year, so this processor upholds the speed demon reputation that the 21164 and 21064 established for Alpha chips.
sentences.zh: Digital 预计 21264 今年的时钟速度将达到 700MHz 以上，因此该处理器保持了 21164 和 21064 为 Alpha 芯片建立的速度恶魔声誉。

blocks.html_en: Alpha is the last RISC architecture for which Microsoft is developing future versions of NT. Microsoft is phasing out NT for MIPS Rx000 chips, and the PowerPC NT never really got off the ground. The only other CPU architecture that runs NT is, of course, Intel x86. Despite Intel's market dominance, the Alpha has one big advantage over the x86: increased performance, especially performance of floating-point tasks. Alpha systems generally cost more than their Intel counterparts, but Alpha systems are faster, and they excel at math-intensive engineering and scientific applications.

sentences.en: Alpha is the last RISC architecture for which Microsoft is developing future versions of NT.
sentences.zh: Alpha 是 Microsoft 正在为其开发 NT 未来版本的最后一个 RISC 架构。

sentences.en: Microsoft is phasing out NT for MIPS Rx000 chips, and the PowerPC NT never really got off the ground.
sentences.zh: 微软正在逐步淘汰用于 MIPS Rx000 芯片的 NT，而 PowerPC NT 从未真正起步。

sentences.en: The only other CPU architecture that runs NT is, of course, Intel x86.
sentences.zh: 当然，唯一运行 NT 的其他 CPU 架构是 Intel x86。

sentences.en: Despite Intel's market dominance, the Alpha has one big advantage over the x86: increased performance, especially performance of floating-point tasks.
sentences.zh: 尽管英特尔占据市场主导地位，但 Alpha 相对于 x86 仍具有一大优势：性能提高，尤其是浮点任务的性能。

sentences.en: Alpha systems generally cost more than their Intel counterparts, but Alpha systems are faster, and they excel at math-intensive engineering and scientific applications.
sentences.zh: Alpha 系统的成本通常高于英特尔同类产品，但 Alpha 系统速度更快，并且擅长数学密集型工程和科学应用。

blocks.html_en: To move beyond the performance limitations of the 20-year-old x86, Intel partnered with HP in 1994 to develop a new CPU architecture: Intel Architecture-64 (IA-64). Intel expects systems that use the Merced processor, the first processor to implement IA-64, to ship in mid-2000. But the Merced might not be the fastest chip on the NT market in 2000. Digital says that by the time Merced appears, the 21264 will be running at a clock frequency of 1000MHz (1 gigahertz [GHz]). At that speed, the 21264 will be substantially faster than the Merced according to estimated CPU benchmarks. (For a review of 21264 speeds, see Figure 1.)

blocks.html_en: Digital said the first 21264 systems would hit the streets in late 1998, so you don't have to wait two years for 64-bit performance. However, the 21264 won't reach its potential until Microsoft ships a 64-bit version of NT for both IA-64 and Alpha chips. (Microsoft hopes to ship the 64-bit NT in 2000.)

sentences.en: Whither RISC?
sentences.zh: RISC 何去何从？

blocks.html_en: The race between the 21264 and IA-64 processors is not just a subject of idle gossip. At stake is nothing less than the future of RISC ­for NT and every other operating system (OS).

sentences.en: The race between the 21264 and IA-64 processors is not just a subject of idle gossip.
sentences.zh: 21264 和 IA-64 处理器之间的竞争不仅仅是闲聊的话题。

sentences.en: At stake is nothing less than the future of RISC ­for NT and every other operating system (OS).
sentences.zh: NT 和所有其他操作系统 (OS) 的 RISC 的未来都处于危险之中。

blocks.html_en: Outside of the highly specialized embedded-application market, RISC is in retreat. Currently, the most popular RISC architecture for the desktop is the PowerPC chip, which IBM and Motorola produce jointly. But the largest customer for desktop PowerPC chips is Apple, and the Macintosh has only about 4 percent of the PC market share according to International Data Corporation (IDC). In June, IBM and Motorola announced that they are dissolving their 7-year PowerPC partnership and will develop future PowerPC chips separately.

sentences.zh: 在高度专业化的嵌入式应用市场之外，RISC 正在退却。

sentences.zh: 6月，IBM和摩托罗拉宣布解除长达7年的PowerPC合作关系，并将分别开发未来的PowerPC芯片。

blocks.html_en: IBM's other RISC architecture, the Power series, is merging with the PowerPC. IBM is phasing out the Power chip as a distinct architecture. The new 64-bit Power3 chip is the first processor that unifies Power and PowerPC technologies.

sentences.zh: 新的64位Power3芯片是首款统一Power和PowerPC技术的处理器。

blocks.html_en: Battling recent losses, Silicon Graphics is moving away from its MIPS Rx000-series RISC processors. Silicon Graphics canceled its next-generation Rx000 projects and recently spun off the embedded-chip portion of MIPS Technologies as a separate company. Silicon Graphics is developing x86-based systems for NT and porting IRIX to IA-64.

sentences.zh: 为了应对近期的亏损，Silicon Graphics 正在放弃其 MIPS Rx000 系列 RISC 处理器。

sentences.en: Silicon Graphics canceled its next-generation Rx000 projects and recently spun off the embedded-chip portion of MIPS Technologies as a separate company.

blocks.html_en: The Alpha is the fastest RISC chip according to most CPU benchmarks and the only NT alternative to the x86. But the Alpha's future isn't certain because of recent shakeups at Digital. The company sold its chip foundry in Hudson, Massachusetts, to Intel. Despite some misleading news reports, Digital sold only the foundry, not the Alpha. Digital will continue to independently design Alpha processors but will farm out the chips' manufacturing to Intel and other licensees. The two current Alpha-manufacturing licensees are Samsung and Mitsubishi. Digital is also negotiating deals with AMD and IBM Microelectronics. Mitsubishi currently has no plans to manufacture the 21264, although the company continues to provide technical support for the low-cost 21164PC chips it manufactured. Samsung has emerged as the most aggressive Alpha licensee. It recently formed a subsidiary to market Alpha chips and says it will push the 21264 to 1GHz by 2000.

blocks.html_en: Compaq's acquisition of Digital makes the Alpha's fate more uncertain. Compaq has never owned a CPU architecture, and the company is one of Intel's largest customers for x86 chips. blocks.html_en: The 21264 has an innovative design that departs significantly from the 21164's design. The new chip has larger primary caches, additional functional units, more accurate branch prediction, new motion video instructions (MVI), and high bus bandwidth. It executes as many as six instructions per clock cycle and sustains four instructions per clock cycle. In addition, the 21264 is the first Alpha to offer out-of-order execution.

blocks.html_en: Out-of-order execution is a feature common to many microprocessors. Now that the Alpha offers this feature, Sun's SPARC chips are the only leading CPUs that don't execute instructions out of order. CPUs that run out of order dynamically rearrange a program's instructions at runtime to use the chip's resources efficiently. For example, if an instruction needs an integer unit but all the CPU's integer units are busy, an out-of-order CPU dispatches floating-point instructions to available floating-point units (FPUs) while holding the stalled integer instruction until an integer unit becomes available. When an integer unit becomes available, the CPU releases the stalled instruction. In the same situation, conventional in-order CPUs stall all instructions until the integer unit is free. Out-of-order CPUs always retire results in their original program order.

blocks.html_en: The best way to evaluate the 21264's out-of-order efficiency is to examine the number of instructions it arranges at once. The more instructions an out-of-order CPU holds at one time, the more efficient its processing is because juggling many instructions gives a CPU a broader view of a running program's needs. However, this juggling act requires resources that in-order processing doesn't require: reorder logic, temporary registers to hold values for pending instructions, interlock circuitry to check for dependencies, and logic to retire the results in program order.

blocks.html_en: Digital implemented a clever register scheme to make this instruction handling possible. Like most RISC chips, the 21264 has an architectural set of 32 integer registers and 32 floating-point registers, all 64 bits wide. To increase the CPU's capacity for reordering instructions, the 21264 has 48 extra integer registers and 40 extra floating-point registers. Any of these 152 registers can hold temporary values for pending instructions. When an instruction retires, the CPU renames the register that holds the temporary result, so that register represents one of the 32 integer or 32 floating-point registers that comprise the 21264's architecture definition. The register's value becomes a valid part of the CPU's state and becomes visible to programs. This scheme for using temporary registers is fairly standard among out-of-order processors, but the 21264 adds a unique twist: It has a duplicate set of 80 integer registers that are copies of the first 80 integer registers, so the 21264 has a total of 160 integer registers.

blocks.html_en: The chip's large number of integer registers is one reason it reaches high speeds despite the added complexity of its out-of-order execution. If all four integer units shared the same 80 registers, the register file would need so many read/write ports that its long bus wouldn't be able to keep up with the chip's clock speed. At 1GHz, the cycle time is 1 nanosecond. Electricity isn't fast enough to support an architecture in which four integer units use 80 registers at a cycle time of 1 nanosecond. So Digital created two clusters, each of which has two integer units (one of which is an integer and address unit) and a set of 80 registers. When an instruction changes a register value, the CPU copies the value to a corresponding register in the other register file to keep the files identical. This process requires one clock cycle, but pipelining and reordering can hide that latency. (For a block diagram of the 21264's architecture, see Figure 2.)

blocks.html_en: The two integer units in each cluster are not identical. One has a multiplier, and the other has special logic to handle five new instructions for motion video processing. The most interesting new instruction (a PERR instruction) replaces nine instructions for motion estimation, which is a critical part of Moving Pictures Experts Group (MPEG) compression and decompression. blocks.html_en: Digital reorganized the cache hierarchy in the 21264. The chip has a 64KB Level 1 instruction cache and a 64KB Level 1 data cache; each is two-way set-associative. The Level 2 cache is off chip; the 21264 accesses it across a 128-bit backside bus. In contrast, the 21164 has much smaller Level 1 caches (8KB each for instructions and data) and a 96KB integrated Level 2 cache. As Digital is moving the Level 2 cache off chip, vendors such as Intel and AMD are introducing their first CPUs with integrated Level 2 caches. Digital found that large programs frequently miss the 21164's 8KB Level 1 caches, so the older CPU accesses the Level 2 cache more often than necessary. The 21164 takes six clock cycles to access its Level 2 cache, and the chip needs an external Level 3 cache to achieve high performance.

blocks.html_en: The first 21264's Level 2 cache will use 200MHz late-write Static RAM (SRAM) chips and will provide 3.2GB per second (GBps) of peak bus bandwidth. In Slot-2 Xeon systems that Intel recently introduced, the bus runs at the full speed of the CPU core. To counter this Intel advancement, Digital will switch to Dual Data Rate SRAM (DDR-SRAM) chips. blocks.html_en: The combination of a 333MHz system bus, a high-bandwidth Level 2 cache bus, and a 6-way superscalar core makes the 21264 state of the art. blocks.html_en: The 21264 uses three branch prediction algorithms. The first predictor focuses on local branches, such as loops. The second predictor keeps a global record of all recent branches. The third predictor decides whether to base the final prediction on the local or global predictor's prediction. The predictors maintain four history tables of previous branches to assist their forecasts. Those tables consume 3.6KB of chip memory. The CPU stores predicted target addresses in the instruction cache; these target addresses consume 6KB. The 21264 provides a lot of space for branch prediction, but Digital claims the 21264's branch prediction capabilities are worth the space because the 21264 mispredicts half as many branches as the 21164, for an overall accuracy rate of about 95 percent.

content_html_zh: [编者注：本文原定发表在 BYTE 杂志 1998 年 9 月号上，但因 1998 年 6 月 BYTE 停刊而被取消。 相反，它出现在 Windows NT 杂志和德国计算机杂志 C'T 上。 本文为英文原文。] 当全世界都在等待英特尔的 64 位 Merced 芯片和微软的 64 位版本的 Windows NT 时，Digital Equipment 正在提供下一代 NT 处理的先睹为快。 Alpha 21264 是运行 NT 的 64 位处理器。 它是世界上最快的芯片之一。 今天就可以使用了。 21264 是最新一代的 Alpha 微处理器架构。 Digital 预计 21264 今年的时钟速度将达到 700MHz 以上，因此该处理器保持了 21164 和 21064 为 Alpha 芯片建立的速度恶魔声誉。 Alpha 是 Microsoft 正在为其开发 NT 未来版本的最后一个 RISC 架构。 微软正在逐步淘汰用于 MIPS Rx000 芯片的 NT，而 PowerPC NT 从未真正起步。 当然，唯一运行 NT 的其他 CPU 架构是 Intel x86。 尽管英特尔占据市场主导地位，但 Alpha 相对于 x86 仍具有一大优势：性能提高，尤其是浮点任务的性能。 Alpha 系统的成本通常高于英特尔同类产品，但 Alpha 系统速度更快，并且擅长数学密集型工程和科学应用。 为了超越已有 20 年历史的 x86 的性能限制，Intel 于 1994 年与 HP 合作开发了一种新的 CPU 架构：Intel Architecture-64 (IA-64)。 英特尔预计使用 Merced 处理器（第一个实现 IA-64 的处理器）的系统将于 2000 年中期上市。 但 Merced 可能不是 2000 年 NT 市场上最快的芯片。 Digital 表示，当 Merced 出现时，21264 将以 1000MHz（1 GHz）的时钟频率运行。 根据估计的 CPU 基准测试，按照这个速度，21264 将比 Merced 快得多。 （有关 21264 速度的回顾，请参见图 1。） Digital 表示，第一批 21264 系统将于 1998 年底上市，因此您不必等待两年即可获得 64 位性能。 然而，直到 Microsoft 为 IA-64 和 Alpha 芯片提供 64 位版本的 NT 后，21264 才能发挥其潜力。 （微软希望在 2000 年推出 64 位 NT。） RISC 何去何从？ 21264 和 IA-64 处理器之间的竞争不仅仅是闲聊的话题。 NT 和所有其他操作系统 (OS) 的 RISC 的未来都处于危险之中。 在高度专业化的嵌入式应用市场之外，RISC 正在退却。 目前，桌面最流行的RISC架构是IBM和摩托罗拉联合生产的PowerPC芯片。 但桌面 PowerPC 芯片的最大客户是苹果公司，根据国际数据公司 (IDC) 的数据，Macintosh 只占 PC 市场份额的 4% 左右。 6月，IBM和摩托罗拉宣布解除长达7年的PowerPC合作关系，并将分别开发未来的PowerPC芯片。 IBM 的另一种 RISC 架构 Power 系列正在与 PowerPC 合并。 IBM 正在逐步淘汰 Power 芯片作为一种独特的架构。 新的64位Power3芯片是首款统一Power和PowerPC技术的处理器。 为了应对近期的亏损，Silicon Graphics 正在放弃其 MIPS Rx000 系列 RISC 处理器。 Silicon Graphics 取消了其下一代 Rx000 项目，并于最近将 MIPS Technologies 的嵌入式芯片部分剥离为一家独立公司。 Silicon Graphics 正在为 NT 开发基于 x86 的系统，并将 IRIX 移植到 IA-64。 Sun Microsystems 正在将 Solaris 移植到 IA-64。 这一举动促使一些行业分析师猜测新的 UltraSPARC-III 将是 SPARC 系列的最后一代主要产品，尽管 Sun 声称这些传言是错误的。 作为摆脱 Precision Architecture-RISC 战略的一部分，HP 正在将 HP-UX 移植到 IA-64。 PA-RISC将在IA-64推出后逐渐退出市场。 IA-64 将向后兼容 PA-RISC。 根据大多数 CPU 基准测试，Alpha 是最快的 RISC 芯片，也是 x86 的唯一 NT 替代品。 但由于 Digital 最近的重组，Alpha 的未来并不确定。 该公司将其位于马萨诸塞州哈德逊的芯片代工厂出售给英特尔。 尽管有一些误导性的新闻报道，Digital 只出售了代工厂，而不是 Alpha。 Digital 将继续独立设计 Alpha 处理器，但会将芯片的制造外包给英特尔和其他授权商。 当前的两家 Alpha 制造授权商是三星和三菱。 Digital 还正在与 AMD 和 IBM 微电子公司进行交易谈判。 三菱目前没有计划生产21264，尽管该公司继续为其生产的低成本21164PC芯片提供技术支持。 三星已成为最积极的 Alpha 授权商。 它最近成立了一家子公司来销售 Alpha 芯片，并表示到 2000 年将把 21264 推向 1GHz。 康柏对Digital的收购让Alpha的命运更加扑朔迷离。 康柏从未拥有过 CPU 架构，该公司是英特尔 x86 芯片的最大客户之一。 Alpha 的高级产品经理 David Jessel 声称 Alpha 粉丝无需担心。 “康柏一直全力支持 Alpha，并将继续对其进行投资，”Jessel 说。 为了强调其对 Alpha 的承诺，康柏计划在其高端 Tandem 服务器中用 21264 替代 MIPS 处理器。 如果 Alpha 在所有这些转变中幸存下来，它可能会在未来十年严重挑战 IA-64 芯片的性能霸主地位。 对 21264 的技术分析表明 Alpha 有足够的空间变得更强大。 21264 内部 21264 具有与 21164 设计显着不同的创新设计。 新芯片拥有更大的主缓存、额外的功能单元、更准确的分支预测、新的运动视频指令（MVI）和高总线带宽。 它每个时钟周期执行多达六个指令，并且每个时钟周期维持四个指令。 此外，21264 是第一个提供乱序执行的 Alpha。 乱序执行是许多微处理器的共同特征。 既然 Alpha 提供了此功能，Sun 的 SPARC 芯片是唯一不会乱序执行指令的领先 CPU。 无序运行的 CPU 在运行时动态地重新排列程序的指令，以有效地使用芯片的资源。 例如，如果一条指令需要一个整数单元，但所有 CPU 的整数单元都忙，则无序 CPU 会将浮点指令分派到可用的浮点单元 (FPU)，同时保留停滞的整数指令，直到整数单元可用。 当整数单元可用时，CPU 释放停滞的指令。 在相同的情况下，传统的有序 CPU 会停止所有指令，直到整数单元空闲为止。 乱序 CPU 总是按其原始程序顺序废弃结果。 乱序执行曾经是只有 Brainiac 处理器的特征，这些 CPU 依靠复杂的指令处理而不是高时钟速度来实现最高性能。 管理旧芯片乱序技术的复杂逻辑排除了高时钟速度。 以前的 Alpha 芯片以行业领先的速度运行，因为它们不会乱序处理指令。 21264 打破了这一传统。 提供 500MHz 和 600MHz 频率，速度绝对很快。 而且会变得更快。 Digital表示，21264今年将达到733MHz，并在两年内达到1GHz。 但 21264 也是一个天才。 它不按顺序执行指令，而且比任何其他处理器都更灵活地执行指令。 评估21264乱序效率的最佳方法是检查它一次排列的指令数量。 无序 CPU 一次保存的指令越多，其处理效率就越高，因为同时处理许多指令可以让 CPU 对正在运行的程序的需求有更广泛的了解。 然而，这种杂耍行为需要按顺序处理不需要的资源：重新排序逻辑、用于保存待处理指令的值的临时寄存器、用于检查依赖性的互锁电路以及用于按程序顺序废弃结果的逻辑。 Intel 的 P6 芯片（Pentium Pro、Pentium II、Celeron 和 Pentium II Xeon）可同时处理多达 40 条指令。 HP 的 PA-8000 可以同时处理 56 条指令。 21264 可处理 80 条指令，比任何其他处理器都多。 Digital 实现了一种巧妙的寄存器方案，使这种指令处理成为可能。 与大多数 RISC 芯片一样，21264 具有 32 个整数寄存器和 32 个浮点寄存器的架构集，全部为 64 位宽。 为了增加CPU重新排序指令的能力，21264有48个额外的整数寄存器和40个额外的浮点寄存器。 这 152 个寄存器中的任何一个都可以保存待处理指令的临时值。 当指令退出时，CPU 会重命名保存临时结果的寄存器，以便该寄存器代表构成 21264 架构定义的 32 个整数或 32 个浮点寄存器之一。 寄存器的值成为CPU状态的有效部分并且对程序可见。 这种使用临时寄存器的方案在乱序处理器中相当标准，但 21264 增加了一个独特的变化：它有一组 80 个整数寄存器的副本，这些寄存器是前 80 个整数寄存器的副本，因此 21264 总共有 160 个整数寄存器。 该芯片的大量整数寄存器是其达到高速的原因之一，尽管其乱序执行增加了复杂性。 如果所有四个整数单元共享相同的 80 个寄存器，则寄存器文件将需要如此多的读/写端口，以至于其长总线将无法跟上芯片的时钟速度。 在 1GHz 时，周期时间为 1 纳秒。 电力的速度还不够快，无法支持四个整数单元以 1 纳秒的周期时间使用 80 个寄存器的架构。 因此Digital创建了两个集群，每个集群有两个整数单元（其中一个是整数和地址单元）和一组80个寄存器。 当指令更改寄存器值时，CPU 会将该值复制到另一个寄存器文件中的相应寄存器，以保持文件相同。 这一过程需要一个时钟周期，但流水线和重新排序可以隐藏该延迟。 （有关 21264 架构的框图，请参见图 2。） 簇和缓存 每个簇中的两个整数单元不相同。 一个具有乘法器，另一个具有特殊逻辑来处理用于运动视频处理的五个新指令。 最有趣的新指令（PERR 指令）取代了九个运动估计指令，这是运动图像专家组 (MPEG) 压缩和解压缩的关键部分。 因此，21264 可以轻松处理实时数字多功能光盘 (DVD) 播放的 MPEG-2 视频解码和 AC-3 音频解码，无需特殊硬件。 21264 有两个共享 72 个浮点寄存器的流水线 FPU。 FPU 每个时钟周期执行多达两条指令。 600MHz 21264 可以维持 1.2 gigaflops，因为整数单元可以在 FPU 的每个时钟周期处理两次加载或存储。 Digital 重新组织了 21264 中的缓存层次结构。 该芯片具有64KB 1级指令缓存和64KB 1级数据缓存；每个都是双向集合关联的。 二级缓存位于片外； 21264 通过 128 位后端总线访问它。 相比之下，21164 具有小得多的一级缓存（指令和数据各 8KB）和 96KB 集成二级缓存。 随着 Digital 将二级缓存移出芯片，英特尔和 AMD 等供应商正在推出其首款集成二级缓存的 CPU。 Digital 发现大型程序经常会错过 21164 的 8KB 一级缓存，因此较旧的 CPU 访问二级缓存的频率超出了必要的范围。 21164需要六个时钟周期来访问其二级缓存，并且该芯片需要外部三级缓存才能实现高性能。 21264 使数字回归到更传统的方法。 该芯片拥有大容量的一级缓存，提高了缓存的命中率。 访问高速缓存需要两个时钟周期，但这种情况几乎是不可避免的，因为高速缓存太大，而21264的时钟速度又太快。 当CPU错过片上缓存时，它通过128位后端总线访问二级缓存。 此 Alpha 不需要 3 级缓存。 第一个 21264 的 2 级高速缓存将使用 200MHz 后期写入静态 RAM (SRAM) 芯片，并将提供每秒 3.2GB (GBps) 的峰值总线带宽。 该统计数据与 450MHz Slot-2 Pentium II 产生的 3.6GBps 峰值总线带宽相当。 Pentium II 有一个连接 2 级高速缓存的 64 位后端总线。 在英特尔最近推出的 Slot-2 Xeon 系统中，总线以 CPU 内核的全速运行。 为了对抗英特尔的这一进步，Digital 将改用双数据速率 SRAM (DDR-SRAM) 芯片。 DDR-SRAM 芯片以 166MHz 运行，但在时钟信号的两个边沿上传输数据，以实现 333MHz 的数据速率和 5.3GBps 的峰值带宽。 最终，21264 的缓存总线将以 250MHz 运行（双时钟实际上为 500MHz），峰值带宽为 8GBps。 在这些速度下，二级缓存可能会跟上 21264 的 1GHz 核心。 总线和分支 21264 不是系统 I/O 总线，而是 64 位点对点通道。 I/O通道比缓存总线更快；它的运行速度高达 333MHz。 它直接连接到 Tsunami 定制芯片组。 Tsunami 芯片组连接到一个或两个以 33MHz 运行的 32 位 PCI 总线，并通过一对 256 位总线（每条以 83MHz 运行）连接到两组主存储器。 在双处理器系统中，Tsunami 芯片组通过独立的 64 位通道连接到第二个 CPU，该通道的运行频率为 333MHz。 （有关 21264 系统架构的描述，请参见图 3。） 该总线设计与 AMD 为其 AMD-K7 处理器授权的设计相同，该处理器将于明年发货。 AMD 正在设计一种名为 Slot A 的新 CPU 接口，该接口将使用与 Intel 的 Slot 1 和单边接触 (SEC) 盒相同的物理连接器。 Slot A 没有使用 Intel 专有的 P6 总线协议，而是借用了 21264 的总线协议。 未来的 AMD-K7 和 21264 处理器将采用适合插槽 A 的类似 SEC 的卡式盒。 AMD-K7 和 21264 主板仅在 BIOS 上有所不同。 对于AMD来说，这种相似性意味着AMD-K7的总线接口将比Intel的总线接口更快。 对于Digital来说，这种相似性意味着未来的21264处理器将适合更低成本的主板，因此Alpha系统的价格将会下降。 Digital 可能会推出一款 21264PC 处理器，与低价的 21164PC 类似。 包含 21264PC 和 A 插槽主板的系统成本可能低至 1500 美元。 333MHz 系统总线、高带宽 2 级缓存总线和 6 路超标量内核的组合使 21264 成为最先进的技术。 为了防止21264瓶颈，Digital升级了CPU的读取和分支预测功能。 该芯片的一级指令高速缓存有一个集合预测器，可以猜测 CPU 接下来将访问高速缓存的两个整数单元寄存器集中的哪一个。 然后，下一行预测器会猜测 CPU 将访问该组中的哪个高速缓存行。 （缓存每行保存四个指令。） 21264 使用三种分支预测算法。 第一个预测器关注局部分支，例如循环。 第二个预测器保留所有最近分支的全局记录。 第三个预测器决定最终预测是否基于局部预测器的预测或全局预测器的预测。 预测器维护先前分支的四个历史表以协助他们的预测。 这些表消耗 3.6KB 的芯片内存。 CPU将预测的目标地址存储在指令缓存中；这些目标地址消耗 6KB。 21264 为分支预测提供了很大的空间，但 Digital 声称 21264 的分支预测功能是值得的，因为 21264 错误预测的分支数量是 21164 的一半，总体准确率约为 95%。 复杂性损失 21264 可以与 IBM 的 Power3 媲美，成为世界上最复杂的微处理器。 21264有1590万个晶体管和一个6路核心。 Power3拥有1500万个晶体管和一个8路核心。 21264 作为六层金属、0.35 微米 CMOS 工艺技术首次亮相。 芯片尺寸为300平方毫米，芯片功耗为60瓦。 到今年年底，Digital 和三星计划将 21264 迁移到 0.25 微米工艺，将时钟速度提高到 667MHz 和 733MHz，同时缩小芯片尺寸。 2000 年，三星将把 21264 转为 0.18 微米工艺，与英特尔在从 Digital 购买的代工厂中生产 Merced 芯片的工艺相同。 三星希望在0.18微米工艺上击败英特尔。 21264 可能会在 125 平方毫米到 150 平方毫米的芯片上突破 1GHz 的障碍。 21264 目前在芯片尺寸、制造成本和功耗方面弥补了其复杂性，但在时钟速度方面却没有弥补其复杂性。 由于 Alpha 编译器的成熟和本地 Alpha 应用程序的丰富，21264 几乎肯定会让 Merced 望尘莫及。 问题是 Alpha 能否在 IA-64 的攻击下幸存下来并在未来保持其性能领先地位。 康柏工程师已经开始研发下一代 CPU。 该公司计划于 2000 年发布 21364，并于 2001 年发布
